slides.name: 让窗口各就各位
textItems: 用工作空间组织窗口，在不同任务之间保持清晰。

items.name: 键盘操作
items.description: 通过快捷键聚焦、移动和管理窗口。

items.name: 多显示器

en.name: A place for every window
textItems: Organize windows into workspaces and move between tasks with clarity.

items.name: Tiling layouts
items.description: Arrange windows automatically and make use of your screen.

items.name: Keyboard driven
items.description: Focus, move, and manage windows with shortcuts.

items.name: Multiple displays
items.description: Organize and switch workspaces across displays.

textItems: Adjust settings with the graphical editor or use an AeroSpace-compatible configuration file.
View and manage workspaces from the menu bar
